Dear Forum Members, At the hardware level, [article_no] is not compatible with previous hardware revisions like [article_no] and [article_no]. analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are discussing how to upgrade and maintain compatibility between versions of [product_name] software and related hardware. There is uncertainty about whether programs made with older software can be opened in the latest version without issues and concerns about hardware incompatibility between new and previous revisions. Members seek confirmation on seamless migration and how upcoming product phaseouts will affect existing setups.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward upgrades to the latest software, with the ability to open and reuse projects from older versions without errors. They also want clear and reliable guidance regarding hardware and software compatibility for future-proof migration planning.
